newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were steady in thin trade on Tuesday, tracking a weaker opening on the Dow and a softer U.S. bond market, dealers said.
"The market has been steady all day with little action," said one trader. "Now the (Wall) Street's come in lower we're seeing a slight mark-down."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was off 16.99 points at 12,381.58. In Hong Kong on Tuesday the Hang Seng Index finished up 110.73 points, or 0.90 percent at 12,398.57.

"Turnover has dropped off incredibly," the trader said. "People are waiting to see where interest rates are going from here, Hong Kong is very property-based and if (U.S.) interest rates rise any more there will be further concern."
